The same family retains entropy log2 while its measure weakly collapses to delta_1 and typical dimension tends to zero at a sharp inverse-logarithmic rate, whereas local dimension at the opposite fixed endpoint diverges. This resolves a concrete geometric-versus-symbolic complexity gap rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
